description: Few-shot examples for parsing single-step arithmetic word problems into a structured form.

examples.input: A fruit basket holds 18 oranges. After 7 are taken, how many remain?
There are 9 trays and each tray has 6 muffins. How many muffins are there in total?
Tomas walked 4 kilometres in the morning and 5 kilometres in the evening. How far did he walk in total?
A cake is cut into 12 equal slices and shared evenly between 3 friends. How many slices does each friend receive?
A library shelf has 24 books. After 9 are borrowed, how many remain?
